NIMBioS continues to lead to discoveries. Here are some ways to keep on top of them:

- **OpenAlex**: Look at products with NIMBioS as an [institution](https://openalex.org/institutions/i122345529) or [funder](https://openalex.org/funders/f4320310889).
- **Google Scholar**: [Page](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C43&q=NIMBioS&btnG=) with results featuring "NIMBioS".
